emails.subject: Open Enrollment Reminder
emails.body: This is your reminder to complete benefits open enrollment by end of week. Log in at the HR portal link below.

emails.subject: Direct Deposit Update Required
emails.body: Please verify your direct deposit information for the upcoming pay period. No changes will result in a delayed payment.

emails.subject: System Update Complete
emails.body: The scheduled system update has been completed successfully. No action is required on your part.

emails.subject: Routine Password Audit
emails.body: As part of our quarterly audit, please confirm your current password meets policy requirements via the internal portal.

emails.subject: Urgent: Account Access Review
emails.body: We have detected irregular access patterns on your account. Please confirm your credentials immediately to avoid suspension.

emails.subject: New Remote Access Tool
emails.body: IT has deployed a new remote access tool. Please download and install it from the link below before your next remote session.

emails.subject: Budget Report Due Friday
emails.body: Just a reminder the Q2 budget report is due Friday COB. Please upload it to the shared drive when ready.

emails.subject: Performance Review Scheduled
emails.body: Your annual performance review has been scheduled for next Tuesday at 2PM. Please come prepared with your self-assessment.

emails.subject: Compliance Certification Required
emails.body: Your annual compliance certification is overdue. Please complete it immediately using the secure link below.

emails.subject: VPN Maintenance Window
emails.body: VPN access will be unavailable this Saturday from 2AM to 6AM for scheduled maintenance.
